1_automated_gate.behaviour: proposed retrain/mutate/revalidate/retire decisions whose target resolves through the persona/registry owners to a paper-only, tenant-owned discovery persona artifact are reviewed then approved as automated_gate; each check is written to the review/approve note and to an append-only evidence sink before state moves. 4_oos_and_trials.behaviour: every child goes through the section-10 ReplicationGate (real OOS backtest, deflated Sharpe) and only passers are registered; the gate adds to the family trial count, and search variants are counted too, so counts accumulate per family across decisions.
